recruiterFAQs.question: Are you currently looking for internships?
recruiterFAQs.answer: Yes. I am actively looking for Software Engineering, Full Stack Development, and Backend Development internship opportunities where I can contribute while learning from experienced engineers.

recruiterFAQs.question: Can you work remotely?
recruiterFAQs.answer: Yes. I am comfortable working in remote, hybrid, or on-site environments and have experience managing personal software projects independently.

recruiterFAQs.question: Why should we hire you?
recruiterFAQs.answer: I enjoy learning by building. Instead of limiting myself to tutorials, I create complete projects that help me understand architecture, backend development, deployment, and AI integration. I am eager to learn, adapt quickly, and contribute to engineering teams.

recruiterFAQs.question: How do you learn new technologies?
recruiterFAQs.answer: I begin with official documentation to understand the fundamentals, then reinforce my learning by building practical projects. This approach helps me gain hands-on experience and understand real-world implementation.

recruiterFAQs.question: What is your biggest weakness?
recruiterFAQs.answer: I tend to be an overthinker, especially when designing application architecture and considering edge cases. While this sometimes means I spend extra time planning, it naturally acts as a massive strength—it helps me write secure, bug-free, and highly maintainable code right from the start.

recruiterFAQs.question: What are your stipend expectations?
recruiterFAQs.answer: My priority is gaining industry experience, learning from experienced engineers, and contributing effectively to the team. I am open to discussing a stipend that aligns with the company's internship structure.

questions.question: Tell me about yourself
questions.answer: Ritu Raj is a Full Stack Developer and AI & Machine Learning student currently pursuing B.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning. He focuses on building modern web applications, backend systems, and AI-powered solutions using technologies like React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Generative AI.

questions.question: What are your main skills?
questions.answer: Ritu's main skills include JavaScript, Python, Java, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, Groq API (Llama 3.3), and LangChain.

questions.question: What technologies do you use?
questions.answer: Frontend technologies include HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and React. Backend technologies include Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, and MongoDB. For AI applications, he primarily works with Groq API (Llama 3.3) and LangChain.

questions.question: Tell me about Orbit AI
questions.answer: Orbit AI is an AI-powered full-stack conversational platform. It integrates Large Language Models with a secure backend architecture and includes AI chat, authentication, conversation history, Markdown support, and AI provider failover.

questions.question: Explain Orbit AI architecture
questions.answer: Orbit AI follows a full-stack architecture with React frontend, Express backend APIs, MongoDB database, and AI integrations using Groq APIs. The application focuses on secure API handling, scalable structure, and intelligent conversations.

questions.question: Tell me about Stayora
questions.answer: Stayora is an Airbnb-inspired rental platform where users can explore and manage properties. It includes authentication, property listings, cloud image uploads, reviews, wishlist functionality, and MongoDB-based data management.

questions.question: Tell me about Scientific Calculator
questions.answer: Scientific Calculator is a frontend web application built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It supports arithmetic operations, trigonometric functions, factorials, permutations, and combinations.

questions.question: Which project are you most proud of?
questions.answer: Orbit AI is one of the most advanced projects because it combines Full Stack Development with Artificial Intelligence. It demonstrates backend architecture, API integration, authentication, and practical Generative AI implementation.

questions.question: Are you available for internship?
